causes.text: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved a CAR T-cell therapy, Yescarta, for an earlier line of treatment in adults with large B-cell lymphoma, significantly expanding the eligible patient population.

source_info.title: FDA approves axicabtagene ciloleucel for second-line treatment of large B-cell lymphoma

effects.text: Gilead Sciences reported that cell therapy sales jumped 79% to $398 million in Q3 2022, helping it beat profit expectations; the stock rose about 4% after-hours on October 27, 2022.

source_info.title: Gilead profit tops expectations despite lower COVID drug sales, outlook raised

causal_reasoning_chain.description: The FDA granted approval for Yescarta to be used as a second-line therapy in large B-cell lymphoma, expanding its eligible patient pool.
This regulatory expansion drove greater adoption by physicians and increased demand for the therapy, boosting sales in subsequent quarters.
In Q3 2022, Gilead reported sharply higher cell therapy sales contributing to an earnings beat; GILD rose about 4% after-hours on October 27, 2022.

rationale: FDA approval expanded the addressable market for Yescarta, driving cell therapy revenue growth that supported Gilead's earnings beat and a positive share-price reaction.
counterfactual_analysis: Without the expanded approval, the eligible market would have been smaller, limiting sales growth and diminishing the subsequent stock reaction.

adversarial_confounders.impact: Helpful for capturing demand, but the catalyst was the regulatory expansion enabling broader use.

details.commentary: Earlier line approval lets Yescarta reach patients who might otherwise rely on chemotherapy or other therapies. A stronger branded position in this broader group reduces the appeal of substitutes and supports pricing power.
FDA approval is a decisive legal gate that suddenly enlarges the addressable market for Yescarta. This regulatory change directly enabled the sharp jump in cell therapy revenue seen in the quarter.

As clinicians gain experience and payers reimburse more cases, usage of Yescarta can build over several quarters. Higher revenue then supports further investment in cell therapy, reinforcing growth of the franchise.
